checks.name: the page loads (TOUCHLINE — PLAYER IMPACT + BALANCE V1 REVIEW)
every case simulates STAGE 2 and STAGE 3 and both viewports draw
the page's numbers equal node's (deepest, torso, legs, ticks > 5 cm, outcome, impacts, each player's severity / balance / action / steps), both stages
STAGE 2 and STAGE 3 draw different replays of the same inputs (the feint into the recovering tackle, 0.3 s after the impact)
SKIN / SKELETON / SKIN + SKELETON draw (skeleton-only differs from skin)
each overlay draws something when on (CONTACT VOLUMES, SUPPORT, CENTRE OF MASS · BALANCE, CONTACT NORMAL, IMPACT VECTOR, RECOVERY STEP, TRAILS, STAGE 2 GHOST, FRAME DATA)
the diagnostics carry the live quantities (contact regions, relative velocity, impact / severity, support, balance, action, interruption, possession, penetration, the referee facts)
the eight cameras draw, each a different view
frame step moves the playhead 4 ticks
shift + frame step moves one tick
1× / 0.5× / 0.25× play at their rates (the playhead after 0.6 s of wall clock)
